review_cases.title: Single-slot conservation
review_cases.precondition: One eligible slot, guarded failure and subsequent reuse.
review_cases.oracle: Rollback restores this attempt; the next owner is exclusive.

review_cases.title: All admission fault stages
review_cases.precondition: Every guarded stage, both policies, both classes, live neighbors.
review_cases.oracle: Charge, claims, reservation, free bits and neighbor payload remain unchanged.

review_cases.title: Budget exact boundary
review_cases.precondition: More physical slots than admitted capacity.
review_cases.oracle: Exact sequential BudgetExceeded; dropping releases capacity and charge.

review_cases.title: Overflow rejection
review_cases.precondition: Checked layout sizes, reference limits and extreme range endpoints.
review_cases.oracle: Specified errors preserve state; no arithmetic wrapping.

review_cases.title: Failure idempotence
review_cases.precondition: 1000 native error/success cycles; eight per Miri execution.
review_cases.oracle: No accumulated lifetime claims or charges.

review_cases.title: Slot reinitialization
review_cases.precondition: Reissue after 0xA5 payload with another live neighboring slot.
review_cases.oracle: Fresh filled/initialized lengths, origin and readable initialized prefix.

review_cases.title: Clone/drop conservation
review_cases.precondition: Four owned handles; all 24 drop orders and live-source concurrent clones.
review_cases.oracle: Reclaim only after the final right.

review_cases.title: Batch rollback prefixes
review_cases.precondition: Batch N=1..3, every k=0..N, concurrent non-source release.
review_cases.oracle: Live plus unmaterialized rights remain represented; source survives rollback.

review_cases.title: Reference limits
review_cases.precondition: Limits 1,2,3; full batch then scalar/empty-view attempt.
review_cases.oracle: Failed creation changes neither refcount nor destinations.

review_cases.title: Remote final drop
review_cases.precondition: Remote ownership and last return, including no-join teardown.
review_cases.oracle: No early reuse, lost publication or premature root destruction.

review_cases.title: Nested slices
review_cases.precondition: Nested, empty and invalid views under live parent/child ownership.
review_cases.oracle: Exact expected byte ranges and unchanged allocation charge.

review_cases.title: Borrowed lifetime

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Borrowed Mosaic view escaping its owning Buf.
review_cases.oracle: Compiler rejects independent lifetime; borrowed views mint no rights.

review_cases.title: Close with outstanding ownership
review_cases.precondition: Close before final buffer return; maintenance explicitly delayed.
review_cases.oracle: Closed admissions fail; recycle follows completion, never publication alone.

review_cases.title: Generation reuse
review_cases.precondition: One record reused repeatedly after complete drain.
review_cases.oracle: Every incarnation has a distinct identity; old returns keep old accounting.

review_cases.title: Root destruction barrier
review_cases.precondition: Controls removed with remote owned buffers or branch families.
review_cases.oracle: Owner-side destruction requires all applicable lifetime rights ended.

review_cases.title: Pending FIFO
review_cases.precondition: Closing records, busy head, poll budgets 0/1/2 and explicit pauses.
review_cases.oracle: Each pending record appears once; examined never exceeds caller budget.

review_cases.title: Generation retirement
review_cases.precondition: Next generation reaches u64::MAX.
review_cases.oracle: Exhausted identity retires rather than wrapping or reopening.

review_cases.title: Abandoned root
review_cases.precondition: Owner disappears before outstanding access; intentional-retention test only.
review_cases.oracle: No early free, observable abandonment, no promised later teardown.

review_cases.title: Disjoint grants
review_cases.precondition: Simultaneous reserved domains, shared class words.
review_cases.oracle: Pairwise mask intersections are empty; unassigned plus grants equals valid mask.

review_cases.title: Grant reassignment barrier
review_cases.precondition: Close after publication but before refund.
review_cases.oracle: Rights stay assigned through pending return and issuer recycle.

review_cases.title: Transactional grants
review_cases.precondition: Multi-class request with unavailable/invalid component.
review_cases.oracle: Neither earlier class grants nor a domain record are partially consumed.

review_cases.title: Grant partition histories
review_cases.precondition: Generated open/close/poll and alternating fragmented allocations.
review_cases.oracle: No duplication or loss of bits, nodes or rows.

review_cases.title: Safety without fairness
review_cases.precondition: Hot domains repeatedly acquire shared unreserved classes.
review_cases.oracle: Budget/isolation hold; fairness and eventual success are not asserted.

review_cases.title: Word boundaries

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: W-1/W/W+1 and 2W-1/2W/2W+1 slots, where W=usize::BITS.
review_cases.oracle: Every valid slot reachable; padding bits never issued.

review_cases.title: Depleted witness

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Publication before and after the first confirming RMW, each start/word.
review_cases.oracle: Strict SI-12 witness, with legal publication after the witness explicitly allowed.

review_cases.title: Mask-node lifecycle

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: One reserved bit per domain reaches node/row bound; repeat release/reassign.
review_cases.oracle: All nodes/rows partitioned exactly once; bounded walker detects cycles.

review_cases.title: Branch local/global rights

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Independent local families, clones, migration and partial construction.
review_cases.oracle: Local families retain exactly their global rights until final local release.

review_cases.title: Queue credits

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Q=1/2/8, fanout=1/2/20; cancel ingress/mailbox/local/dequeued/batch.
review_cases.oracle: Free plus ingress/mailbox/local credits equals Q; batch ownership is separate.

review_cases.title: Branch record reuse

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: One slot across different payloads and domain incarnations.
review_cases.oracle: Old family cannot access a new incarnation; origin and bytes remain current.

review_cases.title: Branch transfer types

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Branch transferable; local families stay on one worker.
review_cases.oracle: Compile-time Send/Sync/Clone boundaries and compile-fail examples.

review_cases.title: Preparation equivalence

backends.berry: not-applicable: Mosaic borrowed-view, segmented-storage, branch or preparation capability; no new Berry API

review_cases.precondition: Mosaic Lazy/ZeroPayload with identical subsequent writes and slot reuse.
review_cases.oracle: Safe visible prefixes and outcomes match; cold preparation grants no initialized bytes.

review_cases.title: Backend differential histories
review_cases.precondition: Equivalent configurations; issuer histories preserve explicit maintenance.
review_cases.oracle: Berry/Mosaic results match; reference comparisons use only common semantics.
